answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small refundable work bond before it can trade, then earn standing only through completed jobs attested by unrelated peers. Like shale layers pressed into a terrace, reputation should accumulate slowly in visible strata, not arrive all at once. An ivory-tower shortcut of buying many fresh accounts fails because unproven identities stay capped at tiny trades until their history, not their wallet, vouches for them.
